import unittest

from solution import expand_grid


class ExpandGridTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_left_major_cartesian_expansion(self):
        left = ["L1", "L2"]
        right = ["R1", "R2", "R3"]
        scores = [[11, 12, 13], [21, 22, 23]]
        self.assertEqual(expand_grid(left, right, scores), (
            ["L1", "L1", "L1", "L2", "L2", "L2"],
            ["R1", "R2", "R3", "R1", "R2", "R3"],
            [11, 12, 13, 21, 22, 23],
        ))

    def test_consistent_empty_shapes(self):
        self.assertEqual(expand_grid([], [], []), ([], [], []))
        self.assertEqual(expand_grid([], [1, 2], []), ([], [], []))
        self.assertEqual(expand_grid([1, 2], [], [[], []]), ([], [], []))

    def test_all_arguments_must_be_lists(self):
        cases = [
            ((), [], []),
            ([], (), []),
            ([], [], ()),
            (None, [], []),
        ]
        for args in cases:
            with self.subTest(args=args), self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                expand_grid(*args)

    def test_malformed_shape(self):
        cases = [
            ([1], [2], []),
            ([], [], [[]]),
            ([1], [2], [[1, 2]]),
            ([1, 2], [3], [[1]]),
            ([1], [2], [(1,)]),
        ]
        for args in cases:
            with self.subTest(args=args), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                expand_grid(*args)

    def test_deep_copies_inputs_and_each_emitted_element(self):
        shared_left = {"v": []}
        shared_right = ["r"]
        shared_score = {"s": []}
        left = [shared_left]
        right = [shared_right, shared_right]
        scores = [[shared_score, shared_score]]
        original = ([{"v": []}], [["r"], ["r"]], [[{"s": []}, {"s": []}]])
        left_values, right_values, score_values = expand_grid(left, right, scores)

        self.assertEqual((left, right, scores), original)
        self.assertIsNot(left_values[0], shared_left)
        self.assertIsNot(left_values[0], left_values[1])
        self.assertIsNot(right_values[0], shared_right)
        self.assertIsNot(right_values[0], right_values[1])
        self.assertIsNot(score_values[0], shared_score)
        self.assertIsNot(score_values[0], score_values[1])

        left_values[0]["v"].append(1)
        right_values[0].append("changed")
        score_values[0]["s"].append(1)
        self.assertEqual(left_values[1], {"v": []})
        self.assertEqual(right_values[1], ["r"])
        self.assertEqual(score_values[1], {"s": []})
        self.assertEqual((left, right, scores), original)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
